title: Materials & Properties
subject: Integrated Studies
description: What are things made of? Wood, metal, plastic, glass — and how they feel and behave!
source: NSC Practice — built from the official MOE Grade 2 curriculum
nscObjectives: Identify common materials (wood, metal, plastic, glass, paper, cloth)
Describe properties of materials (hard, soft, rough, smooth, waterproof)

sections.title: What Things Are Made Of
sections.description: Everything around us is made from a material — wood, metal, plastic, glass, paper, or cloth.

questions.prompt: A school desk and a door are usually made of...
questions.hint: It comes from trees!

questions.prompt: A cooking pot is usually made of...
questions.hint: It's strong, shiny, and doesn't burn on the stove

questions.prompt: A window pane that you can see through is made of...
questions.hint: Be careful — it can break!

questions.prompt: Your school uniform is made of...
questions.hint: Soft material that's sewn into clothes

questions.prompt: Your exercise book is made of...
questions.hint: It's thin, light, and you can write on it

questions.prompt: A water bottle and a lunch box are often made of...
questions.hint: Light, colourful, and doesn't break easily when dropped

questions.prompt: Match each object to the material it is made of:
questions.hint: Think about how each object feels and what job it does

questions.prompt: Select ALL the things that come from trees:
questions.hint: Wood AND paper both start as trees!

sections.title: How Materials Feel
sections.description: Materials have properties — hard or soft, rough or smooth, heavy or light.

questions.prompt: A rock feels ___ and a pillow feels ___.
questions.hint: Squeeze them in your mind — which one squishes?

questions.prompt: Sandpaper feels ___ but glass feels ___.
questions.hint: Rough things feel bumpy and scratchy; smooth things slide under your finger

questions.prompt: Which material can you SEE THROUGH?
questions.hint: That's why windows are made of it — we say it is transparent

questions.prompt: Which of these can BEND without breaking?
questions.hint: Stretchy, bendy things are called flexible

questions.prompt: Select ALL the things that feel SOFT:
questions.hint: Soft things squish when you press them

questions.prompt: Match each object to how it feels:
questions.hint: The hairy coconut husk is bumpy; the marble slides; the kitten is fluffy

sections.title: The Right Material for the Job
sections.description: We choose materials because of their properties. Why is an umbrella NOT made of paper?

questions.prompt: Why is an umbrella made of waterproof material instead of paper?
options: Paper would get soggy and fall apart in the rain
questions.correct: Paper would get soggy and fall apart in the rain
questions.hint: Waterproof means water can't get through!

questions.prompt: Why are cooking pots made of metal and NOT plastic?
options: Plastic would melt on the hot stove
questions.correct: Plastic would melt on the hot stove
questions.hint: Metal can take the heat — plastic can't!

questions.prompt: Why are windows made of glass?
options: Glass lets light in and we can see through it
questions.correct: Glass lets light in and we can see through it
questions.hint: Imagine a wooden window — you couldn't see outside!

questions.prompt: Rain boots are made of rubber because rubber is...
questions.hint: Rubber keeps your feet dry in puddles!

questions.prompt: Which material would be the WORST choice for building a house roof in Jamaica's rainy season?
questions.hint: Heavy rain would turn cardboard to mush!

questions.prompt: Match each job to the best material:
questions.hint: Blankets must be soft, mirrors shiny and smooth, gates strong

questions.prompt: Type the missing word: 'A material that does NOT let water through is called water___.'
questions.hint: water + ____ = the word for 'keeps water out'
